title: Inside the Agent
subtitle: from first tool call to autonomous agent
description: 120 hands-on articles across 13 modules — build real AI agents inside Cursor and Claude Code, the tools professionals actually use. Tool use, RAG, MCP, context engineering, memory, the Claude Agent SDK, multi-agent orchestration, evals, security, and production deployment — every lesson read, built, and shipped in a real editor, ending in benchmarked capstones.
curriculumHint: Every article runs concept → build → ship — the idea, a hands-on lab in Cursor or Claude Code, and a graded task you keep. Where a lesson needs a prerequisite it links to Getting Started or Beyond the Prompt instead of repeating it.

faqs.a: It's the flagship — intermediate to advanced. The first two modules onboard you to Cursor and Claude Code from zero, but from Module 3 on you build with Python, APIs, and databases. Brand new to coding? Do Getting Started first. New to prompting? Do Beyond the Prompt first.

faqs.q: What should I know before starting?
faqs.a: Comfort with the terminal, basic Python and Git, and a working grasp of how LLMs behave. Wherever a lesson needs a prerequisite, it links to Getting Started or Beyond the Prompt rather than re-teaching it.

Everything is built inside Cursor and Claude Code — the environment professionals actually use — plus the Claude Agent SDK and MCP, with a light, honest tour of orchestration frameworks. The concepts (RAG, MCP, memory, evals, deployment) are universal and transfer to any stack.
Roughly 25–35 hours of focused, hands-on work, fully self-paced — there's no deadline.

faqs.q: What will I be able to do by the end?
faqs.a: Design, build, evaluate, secure, and deploy real autonomous agents — and ship a portfolio of them, finishing with four benchmarked capstones you can show an employer.
Yes — the entire path is completely free.
